Game Overview

In Tower Defense - The Last Realm, the core idea is straightforward: strategically place and upgrade seven distinct tower types to defend your kingdom across 40 thrilling levels. Each decision in Tower Defense: The Last Realm requires wit and precision as you face escalating waves of foes. Enhance your towers and conquer three difficulty tiers for a dynamic and engaging defense experience.
